notes.text:
H-bridge noise suppression and pull-down edit:
- Preserved existing bridge; added fresh Device:C C1=100nF across M1 and fresh Device:R R5/R6=10k from J1/J2 inputs to plain GND.
- At Z3, C1 endpoints (559,677)/(602,677) route via x538/x623 to motor wires y525. Visible junction dots confirm both attachments.
- R5 upper endpoint (246,437) connects to J1 wire y399; duplicate existing GND to lower endpoint (246,512).
- R6 upper endpoint (246,639) must route right to (267,639), then (267,614) on J2's existing junction. Attempting vertical attachment at (246,614) hit connector pin body and discarded the unfinished wire. Actual pin endpoint/wire junction matters; inspect open circles.
- R6 lower endpoint (246,715) accepts duplicated plain GND. J1/J2 remain distinct input nets.
- Scroll caused extreme zoom; Home then two F1 presses gave usable Z3 view.
- Step 38 confirms no title star and explicit saved status: /home/cua/kicad_project/kicad_motor-driver_circuit/kicad_motor-driver_circuit.kicad_sch.
- Prior simple edits scored 1.00, supporting GUI save/edit workflow. Current task has no evaluator score; connectivity is visually checked against intent, not independently parsed or simulated.
